blocks.text: Here is where the office stands for the rest of the week, and I am copying everyone so the question does not come round twice: we close at midday today, we are shut Thursday and Friday for the holiday, the answering service has the telephones from noon until Monday morning, and the mail is being held at the post office rather than delivered, so that nothing sits in the box while we are out.

The supply order is the one thing still outstanding, and it has to go in before we lock up. If you want something added, tell James Weiss within the hour rather than on your way out, since he is placing it before he leaves.
